summary: Review B (security) of Phase S3 at 33f608d confirms F1-F3 of Green round 7. F1: the block selection is now linear; 20000/20000 lines take 0.020 s (17.148 s at 0b6670d), and 1000000/1000000 lines take 0.959 s. The selection gives the same result as 0b6670d on 20000 random logs. F2: contracts.md:118-119 holds the exact range text, and it agrees with the code. F3: the 213407f note has an appended correction. No attack result changed, and 4408 old logs give no feedback. Three nonblocking items stay open; they were not routed.
security_applicability_reason: test-strategy.md:173 says Review B is applicable for Phase S3 with full scope on the parser and its call. Commit 478b723 in the phase diff a1a9396..33f608d changes dispositions_feedback in skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py, and cmd_role_gate calls it for every role.
nonblocking_findings: Carried from review-b-s3-0b6670d.json item 2 (not routed; the adversarial role adds the selection tests): tests/spec_review_gate/test_checker.py has no case for the inner start line, the trailing start line, 'START / x / END / bad / END', the end line before the start line, or the second dispositions line in one block. git diff 0b6670d HEAD -- tests/ is empty.

Carried from review-b-s3-0b6670d.json item 3 (not routed): when no exact start line or end line exists, or a separator other than LF hides a line, dispositions_feedback gives no feedback and has_agent_result still accepts the log by substring. Live role-gate probes at 33f608d still give exit 0 for CR-only line endings, a BOM, a NUL, a start line inside another line, U+200B, U+2028, U+0085, VT, a Cyrillic letter in a marker, and an end line without a start line.

Carried from review-b-s3-0b6670d.json item 6 (not routed): DISPOSITIONS_ITEM_RE at measure_interphase_checks.py:83 still accepts U+2028 in CONTEST text (live probe exit 0). 'Dispositions:' with a capital D, 'dispositions :', a fullwidth colon, and a Cyrillic 'o' in the prefix still give no feedback.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD printed 33f608d57ba7a0935eafed123c6648e6e9c59d0f, which equals audited_head_sha and role_base_sha. git status --short printed only '?? extensions/' (out of scope) before the artifacts were written.

git diff 0b6670d 33f608d: 478b723 changes only measure_interphase_checks.py (dispositions_feedback selection and docstring) and contracts.md:118-119. 33f608d adds one plan.md line. tests/ and measure/tracks.md do not change.
Green result block in jr-green-s3-r7.log line 12: 'dispositions: F1=FIX; F2=FIX; F3=FIX'. F1-F3 map to items 1, 4, and 5 of review-b-s3-0b6670d.json.

F1 confirmed: 'any(start < index for start in starts)' became 'first_start < index' with first_start = starts[0]. The start list comes from enumerate, so it is in ascending order, and the two tests are equal. probe-review-b-3.py: 0 differences between the parser at 33f608d and the parser at 0b6670d on 20000 random logs from nine line kinds.

F1 timing (direct calls, end lines before start lines plus one invalid block): 20000/20000 0.020 s at 33f608d and 17.148 s at 0b6670d; 100000/100000 0.099 s; 1000000/1000000 0.959 s; 500000 end/start pairs 1.072 s. Each result is 'invalid dispositions line: F1=BOGUS'. probe-review-b-2.py: 20000/20000 without an invalid block 0.012 s.

Other costs (probe-review-b-2.py): 1000000 start lines and one end line 0.557 s; 500000 blocks 0.405 s; one start line and 2000000 lines 0.560 s; 200000 dispositions lines 0.132 s; one 50 MB dispositions line 8.651 s. The last value comes from the item loop, which 478b723 does not change, and it was 8.456 s at 0b6670d.

F2 confirmed: probe-review-b-3.py compared contracts.md lines 118 and 119 with the exact expected text; both compare True. The docstring at measure_interphase_checks.py:429-436 uses the same words. The rule agrees with the code: 'S / bad / E' with the start line on line 1 exits with feedback, 'S / x / E / bad / E' and 'E / S / bad / E' give 'invalid dispositions line: F1=BOGUS', and 'S / x / E / bad' gives no feedback. The parser at 0b6670d gives the same four results.

F3 confirmed: git notes show 213407f ends with 'Correction (S3 round 4): a dispositions: line after the last END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT line does not count, so that Red case exits 0, as test_checker.py checks.'

probe-review-b-1.py: the 42 role-gate --role strategy logs in a temporary git repository give the same exit codes as at 0b6670d. Each inner-start, trailing-start, nested, end-before-start, second-line, CRLF, and whitespace attack exits 1. The control valid log, the two contract-conformant last-block logs, and the Red case exit 0. The timing tail of this script stopped with an AttributeError in its own module load on Python 3.14 (no sys.modules entry); probe-review-b-2.py and probe-review-b-3.py cover the timing.

Backward compatibility (probe-review-b-2.py): the parser at 33f608d and the parser at b1d1530 ran over 4408 logs in 19 project roots, with 62 logs from this repository. The run gave 0 non-empty feedback lists, 0 differences, and 0 exceptions. 5 logs hold a dispositions line.
The fail-open checks of test-strategy.md:174-175 hold: dispositions_feedback catches no exception, and the strategy role gave exit 1 for each invalid line in probe-review-b-1.py.
